title: Remove deprecated `value` field from findData response, enforce spec-compliant `records` only
body:
`findData` returned both `records` and `value` pointing to the same array. `value` was an OData legacy alias never defined in `FindDataResponseSchema`, causing triple-fallback patterns (`result.records || result.value || []`) across consumers.

### Protocol implementation
- **`packages/objectql/src/protocol.ts`** — Removed `value: records` from `findData` return. Only `records` is emitted, matching the spec.

### Studio
- **`apps/studio/src/components/ObjectDataTable.tsx`** — Removed `result?.value` fallback from 3 call sites
- **`apps/studio/test/api.test.ts`** — Removed `response?.value` from `extractRecords` helper

### Example app
- **`examples/app-host/public/index.html`** — `json.value` → `json.records`
- **`examples/app-host/test/e2e.test.ts`** — `result.value` → `result.records`

### Docs / changelog
- **`CHANGELOG.md`** — Documented as breaking change under `[Unreleased]`
- **`apps/studio/ROADMAP.md`** — Marked response normalization task (0.2) as done

### Not changed (intentional)
- `ODataResponseSchema` retains `value` — that's the OData v4 standard. Protocol-to-OData adaptation belongs in the HTTP dispatch layer.
- `FindDataResponseSchema` and client `PaginatedResult` type were already correct.
